versions.content: If parameter FrIf_ClstIdx of FrIf_GetState has an invalid value and if development error detection is enabled (i.e. FrIfDevErrorDetect equals ON), the func- tion FrIf_GetState shall report development error code FRIF_E_INV_CLST_IDX to the Det_ReportError service of the DET module.
